senses.gloss: बुद्धि- + इन्द्रिय बुद्धि- + इन्द्रिय (or ज्ङान-), n. an organ of perception and intellect, as the mind, eye, ear, etc., Man. 2, 91.
बुद्धि- + जीविन् बुद्धि- + जीविन्, adj. intelligent.

बुद्धि बुद्धि, i. e. बुध् + ति, f.
 1. Understanding, Bhāṣāp. 50; Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 24; Pañc. 81, 5.
 2. Reflexion, Rām. 3, 48, 14.
 3. Intellect, Pañc. i. d. 219.
 4. Mind, Pañc. i. d. 87; Chr. 5, 8.
 5. Thought, Rām. 3, 48, 14; intention, Pañc. v. d. 83.
 6. Knowledge, Bhāṣāp. 165.
 7. Opinion, Hit. 81, 14 (व्याघ्र-, mistaking him for a tiger).
 8. Presence of mind, Pañc. ii. d. 6.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πύστις.

बुद्धितस् बुद्धि + तस्, adv.
 1. = abl. of बुद्धि, Bhāṣāp. 121.
 2. By the mind, Rām. 6, 95, 54.
बुद्धिमन्त् बुद्धि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Endowed with understanding, Man. 1, 96; intelligent, Pañc. iii. d. 40; wise, Pañc. i. d. 219.
बुद्बुद बुद्बुद, m. A bubble, Utt. Rāmac. 88, 3; Pañc. 203, 6.
बुद्धि- + सागर बुद्धि- + सागर, m. a proper name, or rather, plenty of wisdom, or having plenty of wisdom, Lass. 6, 2.
